summary: Completed full-stack validation of operator transactions, offline sync, manager authentication, dashboard tabs, demo data, anomaly and receivables tracking.
action_items: Restrict CORS to explicit configured origins instead of wildcard with credentials.
Correct the local offline Berondol WAC calculation to use berondolEffCost/berondolEffKg.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py configures allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True; this is unsafe and conflicts with explicit-origin auth guidance.
frontend/src/context/SyncContext.jsx computes wacBerondol from berondolCost rather than berondolEffCost, so Grade B returns can produce an incorrect local WAC while offline.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST Farmer purchase and one TEST trip through public APIs; manager UI also loaded demo data, which resets operational demo collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth, weighing receipt, pool, trip calculations, expense, history, sync, dashboard, anomaly, receivables, farmers, settings and demo seed were exercised. Auth modal test ids are admin-email-input, admin-password-input, submit-auth-btn.
rca of the issue: No runtime failures reproduced. Offline WAC defect is a source-level arithmetic mismatch: berondolEffCost is calculated including Grade B returns, but wacBerondol divides the original berondolCost. CORS wildcard is a security/configuration issue rather than a current-path failure.
